name: ChainMath
description: ChainMath is a procedurally generated evaluation benchmark designed to stress-test sequential arithmetic reasoning and chain-tracking capabilities in Large Language Models (LLMs) across 5 languages (English, Spanish, French, German, Italian). Key characteristics:- 200 chained questions per benchmark instance with varying dependencies and distractors.- Difficulty-weighted scoring (Levels 1 to 5).- Penalties for JSON schema non-compliance and out-of-order outputs.- Anti-contamination design: procedurally generated from numeric seeds. Round 1 evaluation covers Claude Haiku 5.5, Gemini 3.6 Flash, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, ChatGPT 5.6 Luna, and Qwen 3.8-Max.
